text: The identity ∭_V (∇·F) dV = ∯_{∂V} F · dS, converting a volume integral into flux through the closed boundary surface, is:
choices: the fundamental theorem of line integrals
explanation: The book states the divergence theorem as ∭_V (∇·F) dV = ∯_{∂V} F · dS, equating the volume integral of the divergence to the outward flux through the closed boundary. Stokes' theorem instead relates the surface integral of the curl to a line integral around a boundary curve (∬_S (∇×F)·dS = ∮_{∂S} F·dl), and Green's theorem is its 2D analogue. All three are special cases of the generalized Stokes' theorem ∫_M dω = ∫_{∂M} ω.
